facts.fact: An ASIN staff member writes that Benin's X-Road exchange platform, adopted through UXP, launched in March 2020 with three registers and now connects 183 information systems.
The same post gives the public counters at xroad.bj as 74 members and 515 services, with 183 information systems connected.
The post reports more than one million requests a day through the platform.

An ASIN staff member writes that every international partner works with a Beninese company and ASIN teams, which makes ASIN autonomous in running the national X-Road interoperability platform linking 74 members; the platform was adopted through UXP rather than built in-house.
